responsibility: Implements the core hand-written GCC backend for Renesas M32R, wiring the target hooks that are not expressed directly in the .md file. This source owns M32R-specific option override logic, attribute handling, register and ABI setup, argument passing and return-value rules, frame-size computation plus prologue/epilogue expansion, PIC and small-data handling, section/symbol encoding, address legitimacy and constant legality checks, assembler operand printing, scheduling/cost decisions, block-move expansion, trampolines and cache-flush support, and miscellaneous helpers used by md patterns and predicates.
same_name_distinction: Hand-written C++ implementation file for the M32R port: unlike m32r.md it provides hook bodies and helper routines that the machine description calls or complements, unlike m32r.h it executes target policy rather than declaring target macros/constants, and unlike m32r.opt it consumes the parsed target-option state (such as code model, PIC, cache-flush, and small-data settings) to implement backend behavior.
